ideas.title: Set a lower effort level on the simple workers and measure it
ideas.problem: workers.run() builds the claude -p command (workers.py line 87: --output-format json, --no-session-persistence, --max-turns, --model, --tools) and never passes --effort. Every worker therefore runs at Claude Code's default level. Anthropic's effort page says Sonnet 5.5 defaults to high and that for well-specified multistep tool tasks you should 'start with medium'; lower effort also 'means fewer and terser tool calls'. Our Sonnet 5.5 workers (Vera, Doulya, Serge, Sage, Omar, Scout) have short, tightly specified jobs. I found no effort setting anywhere in settings.py or rules.py.
ideas.proposal: Step 1 (free, no code): run Vera once as today and once with the environment variable CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL=medium set by hand on the same idea; compare num_turns, api_value_usd and her verdict from the usage table (cp.usage_today). Repeat for Sage (short brief). Step 2, only if cost drops 15% or more and the verdict and the sources are unchanged: add a settings.WORKER_EFFORT dict ({'Vera': 'medium', 'Doulya': 'medium', ...}; absent = no flag) and in workers.run() add `if effort: cmd += ['--effort', effort]`; expose it as a rule worker.effort.<Agent> in rules.py so Atlas can change or undo it. Keep Israa, Calina, Rana, Tarek and Ghassan at the default: their work is judgement or long writing, where Anthropic says higher effort can matter. If the CLI rejects the flag (older bundled version), log it and run without it, the same way workers.py already handles --system-prompt-file.
ideas.gain: Fewer thinking tokens and fewer tool calls on the subscription workers, so more daily allowance (SUBSCRIPTION_DAILY_VALUE_USD) is left for Calina, Israa and Tarek. Target: 15-30% lower api_value_usd for Vera, Doulya and Sage with an unchanged verdict. Measured from the usage table, no guessing.
ideas.test: 1) Normal: Vera on a past idea with a known verdict, effort medium; pass = same verdict and Path, api_value_usd lower by 15% or more. 2) Edge: Sage on a topic that needs 8 searches; pass = still 6+ distinct sources opened and the brief keeps its primary-source quotes (Anthropic warns that at low effort a model may skip a search). 3) Failure: an agent given an effort value its model does not support (for example xhigh on a model that lacks it); pass = workers.run logs the problem and falls back to the default instead of failing the job.
ideas.confidence_why: Rests on Anthropic's effort and CLI docs (A) saying medium suits well-specified agent tasks and that --effort works in the CLI. Weakest link: no measured result on OUR prompts, and Claude Code's own default for -p was not found, so the gain could be small if it already uses medium.
ideas.risks: Lower effort can make a worker skip a search or a check (Anthropic says so for Haiku 5.5 at low). Keep to medium, not low, and check Sage's source counts. Judge quality may drop quietly, so compare verdicts on past ideas before turning it on. Easy to back out: remove the rule value.
